facts.quote: The full-scale measurement voltage produced on ranges below 40 MOhm does not forward-bias silicon diodes or transistor junctions enough to cause them to conduct. ... Full-scale measurement voltage in the 40-MOhm range does forward-bias a diode or transistor enough to cause it to conduct.
